title: Side Trails
tagline: Experiments and independent projects from Waypoint.
message: Waypoint Deck is the active Side Trail. Older experiments remain archived below — not Studio flagships.

projects.title: Waypoint Deck
projects.tagline: Offline-first Linux field computer · local AI · maps, weather, radio, knowledge.
projects.description: An independent Side Trail exploring resilient field computing when connectivity is poor or gone. Planned capabilities include offline maps/GPS, local AI, weather, radio/SDR, offline reference knowledge, sensors, and situational awareness (including Global Signals concepts when online). Early-stage — do not assume these systems already ship.

projects.title: SignalTerrain
projects.tagline: Archived research — possible Deck situational-awareness input.
projects.description: Cyber / network situational research preserved for possible Waypoint Deck inputs. Not a standalone Studio product or equal peer to Deck.

projects.title: Global Signals
projects.tagline: Archived research — intended Deck input when connectivity exists.
projects.description: Relationship-intelligence experiments preserved as a conceptual information source for Waypoint Deck when online — alongside weather, GPS, radio, and local knowledge. Not a standalone Studio product.

projects.title: OpenRoad PA
projects.tagline: Retired — not an active Waypoint product.
projects.description: Pennsylvania public road-project tracking was explored here. It is retired. Reusable mapping ideas may live elsewhere; this is not a flagship or active Side Trail peer to Deck.
